answer: Jurors stake 21% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The lotus panel is drawn blind, the ferrous escrow settles at close, and comet lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 346 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
